title: Schema.org JobPosting
description: A listing that describes a job opening in a certain organization.

description.description: A description of the job posting.

datePosted.description: Publication date of an online listing.

validThrough.description: The date after when the listing is not valid.

jobLocation.description: A (typically single) geographic location associated with the job position.

applicantLocationRequirements.description: The location(s) applicants can have their workplace.

jobLocationType.description: A description of the job location (e.g., TELECOMMUTE for telecommute jobs).

baseSalary.description: The base salary of the job.

educationRequirements.description: Educational background needed for the position.

experienceRequirements.description: Description of skills and experience needed for the position.

qualifications.description: Specific qualifications required for this role.

skills.description: A statement of knowledge, skill, ability, task or any other assertion expressing a competency.

industry.description: The industry associated with the job position.

occupationalCategory.description: A category describing the job, preferably using a BLS O*NET-SOC taxonomy.

workHours.description: The typical working hours for this job.

jobBenefits.description: Description of benefits associated with the job.

incentiveCompensation.description: Description of bonus and commission compensation aspects of the job.

directApply.description: Indicates whether an url that is set as the listing for this job goes directly to the site of the business.

identifier.description: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier.

sameAs.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity.
